extras: API keys are stored locally in your vault's .obsidian/plugins/art-de-one/data.json file and are never sent anywhere except your configured API endpoint.
intentEvidence: Highlight text, build tables, and ask AI — all inside Obsidian.
problem: Users need integrated tools within Obsidian to quickly query AI about selected content, format complex data into tables, and visually mark important text.
summary: A utility plugin that allows users to interact with AI via selected text, create and edit Markdown tables, and apply custom text highlights.
